endCondition.description: Triggered when one or both provision markers on your Cooking wheel reach the end symbol; everyone takes one final turn.

tiebreakers.description: If a tied player triggered the end of the game, that player wins.
Otherwise the tied player who would be next to take a turn wins.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Building end-game effects vary per building, so entered as one number. Solo mode (5 years, own high score) not modelled.
